# PHO Klinik 2 for Psykiatriske Lidelser - Horsens

PHO Klinik 2 for Psykiatriske Lidelser - Horsens is a clinical unit that appears in the ADHD-databasen 2024 report in connection with **Indikator 10**, a new quality measure tracking whether adult ADHD patients' need for social support was assessed within 120 days of starting treatment [^src1][^src2]. The clinic is recorded as achieving 100 percent fulfilment of this indicator [^src1][^src2], but the underlying case count is very small — the reported range of "3-100" signals that the 100 percent figure rests on a limited data foundation rather than a large, statistically robust sample [^src1][^src2].

This result sits within a broader national picture described in the surrounding report context: Indikator 10 was reported for the first time in the 2024 ADHD database, and it revealed substantial shortfalls in meeting the national quality target of 90 percent, with national fulfilment at only 37 percent and regional fulfilment ranging from 14 to 52 percent. The steering group behind the database discussed the causes of this low fulfilment rate, pointing to registration practices and data quality issues in child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinics and private hospitals, and decided to work on improving registration practices going forward. PHO Klinik 2 for Psykiatriske Lidelser - Horsens's headline 100 percent score stands out against this backdrop precisely because of its thin evidentiary base, which the report itself flags as a caveat rather than a genuine sign of strong performance.

No relationships, additional claims, or timeline events involving this clinic are documented in the available material beyond its appearance in these two page ranges of the ADHD_2024 report.
